scope: Documentary primary-authority audit only; no likelihood minimization and no B-L point evaluated.

primary_analysis.citation: M. Cadeddu et al., JHEP 01 (2021) 116, arXiv:2008.05022v3

csi.support: 12 bins i=4..15 of the first-observation CsI spectrum
csi.statistic: Gaussian least-squares chi2_CsI with signal, background and quenching-factor nuisance penalties

argon.support: Analysis A, 0 <= Eee < 120 keVee, 12 bins of width 10 keVee
argon.statistic: Gaussian least-squares chi2_Ar with CEvNS, PBRN and LBRN normalization nuisance penalties and BRN energy-shape term in per-bin variance

primary_analysis.combined_convention: Independent detector contributions are combined by adding the detector least-squares functions; detector-specific nuisance parameters remain detector-specific absent contrary primary provenance.

official_releases.audit_result: Data, acceptance/response and basic interaction/example material are present; no same-analysis combined CsI+Ar likelihood reference point or combined-fit benchmark is supplied.

Observed data, CEvNS/background PDFs, efficiency, parameters, systematics and plotting/reading helpers are present; no same-analysis combined CsI+Ar likelihood reference point or combined-fit benchmark is supplied.

acceptable_forms_required_by_prereg: published SM best-fit or minimum chi-square/likelihood value with sufficient definition
published profiled nuisance best-fit values plus expectation sufficient for a frozen tolerance
official collaboration example-code likelihood output/reference point from the same releases
benchmark_search.paper_notes: The paper publishes exclusion contours and mentions a Delta-chi2 > 120 statement for the universal-model (g-2)_mu region, but this is not an exact SM/background combined-likelihood reference point and cannot define a non-circular reproduction tolerance.
forbidden_substitutes: manual/raster reading of B-L or universal exclusion contours

next_action: Retire the exact combined-likelihood B-L route unless genuinely new primary benchmark authority appears. No (m_V,g_BL) scan is permitted. Return to the highest-value actionable OPEN funnel class; currently G3 is physically open but not executable, G2 and G8 are blocked, so the next research action must identify a genuinely new class-level executable route rather than weakening 0074c.
